title: Neural networks become centroid classifiers when trained on heavily corrupted inputs
abstract: arXiv:2606.11319v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Learning from imperfect data is a central theme in machine learning, connecting practical questions of robustness to fundamental questions of learnability. Here we examine attribute noise: learning from corrupted inputs while keeping the labels intact, a setting that has received considerably less analytical attention than its label-noise counterpart. We consider two types of corruption models: additive noise and replacement noise. Through experiments with multi-layer perceptrons (MLPs) on corrupted classification datasets, we find that neural networks remain robust, maintaining well-above-chance accuracy even when inputs are >90% corrupted -- far beyond human recognition. To understand this robustness, we analyze infinite-width networks in the heavy-corruption regime using a mean-field-inspired approach and derive a leading-order decision rule for the classification outcome: the network implements a prototype rule, the nearest-class

translated_title: 当在严重损坏的输入上训练时，神经网络会变成质心分类器
translated_abstract: 从不完美的数据中学习是机器学习的核心主题，它将鲁棒性这一实际问题与可学习性这一基本问题联系起来。本文研究属性噪声：即在标签保持完好的情况下从损坏的输入中学习，这一设定相比于标签噪声受到的分析关注要少得多。我们考虑两类损坏模型：加性噪声和替换噪声。通过在损坏的分类数据集上对多层感知机进行实验，我们发现神经网络依然保持鲁棒，即使输入损坏超过90%——远超人类识别能力的极限——其准确率仍远高于随机猜测水平。为了理解这种鲁棒性，我们采用受均值场启发的方法分析了重度损坏情形下的无限宽网络，并推导出分类结果的主导阶决策规则：网络实现了一种原型规则，即最近类……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究发现神经网络对超过90%的输入损坏仍保持远高于随机水平的准确率，并通过均值场理论分析证明，在重度损坏情形下无限宽神经网络会退化为最近质心（原型）分类器。
en_tdlr: The paper shows that neural networks maintain well-above-chance accuracy even with over 90% corrupted inputs, and via a mean-field analysis proves that infinite-width networks under heavy corruption reduce to nearest-centroid (prototype) classifiers.
